title: Cheap, gets stuck easily and broke
text: Cheap, gets stuck easily and broke. The mechanism gets stuck and I fixed it twice, the last time it broke completely. I've only used it to make cookies 4x.

product_metadata.title: Wilton Stainless Steel Small Cookie Scoop, Silver
features: READY, SET, BAKE: Keep cookies uniform in size and shape with help from our easy-to-use Wilton small stainless steel cookie scoop
BAKEWARE FOR EVERY DAY AND EVERY OCCASION: The Wilton cookie scoop makes it easy to scoop and bake evenly-sized cookies; great for everyday and holiday baking
CONVENIENT: The Wilton cookie scoop can hold up to 4 teaspoons of dough and features a squeeze spring handle for an easy release after you scoop
CARE INSTRUCTIONS: For best results, wash the Wilton cookie scoop in warm, soapy water before first and after each use; rinse and dry thoroughly
description: All of your cookies will be almost the exact same size and shape when you use this stainless steel cookie scoop. It has a 4 teaspoon capacity and a squeeze handle for easy release of dough.
